name: 00 Unit
source: [Spoiler]The 00 Unit, humanity's trump card in the battle against the BETA, is the Kagami Sumika of the world of Alternative. Initially reduced to a brain by the BETA's experiments, her mind was later transferred into a silicon-based body to facilitate communication with the BETA. She possesses vast psychic powers.[/spoiler]
